import datetime as dt, re, math
now=dt.datetime.now()
year=now.year
print('year',year)

# login
file_pw=[c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
access_token=apis.file_system.login(username='chrharrison@gmail.com', password=file_pw)['access_token']

entries=apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/bills/', recursive=True, access_token=access_token)
# filter cable bills for current year: /bills/cable/{year}-MM.txt
cable_files=sorted([p for p in entries if p.startswith('/home/christina/bills/cable/') and f'/{year}-' in p and p.endswith('.txt')])
print('cable_files',cable_files)

amounts=[]
for p in cable_files:
    content=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=p, access_token=access_token)['content']
    m=re.search(r"Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", content)
    if not m:
        print('no total found in',p)
        print(content[-300:])
        continue
    amt=float(m.group(1))
    amounts.append((p,amt))
    print('file',p,'amt',amt)

total=sum(a for _,a in amounts)
print('total',total)
print('count',len(amounts))
